question: Can a strict immutable authored preparation book drive actual existing draft/review/confirm and legal equipped actions without granting resources, levels or completion, while rejecting malformed content atomically before host exposure?
beneficiary: Original preparation content author and the same actual field traveler; production contract, not human-utility or balance validation.
selected_boundary: Existing FieldJourney consumes a startup-frozen book; no new gameplay engine, application, save or package. Child catalog/identity/gameplay owners retain authority.

rivals.cosmetic_only: Names/cards may change while actual equipped actions do not; actual valid content variant moves Draw to slot2 and must change real slot1/slot2 availability.
rivals.fallback_grants: Malformed rows may be silently repaired, normalized or grant a fallback; bad whole books must refuse before READY and valid prefix cannot be exposed.
rivals.metadata_as_permission: Declared minimum level or card ID may grant Dash early; actual earned level must remain authoritative.
rivals.proposal_as_confirmation: A proposed/reviewed card may be depicted or applied as confirmed; independent body/provenance checks reject this before explicit confirmation.
rivals.hidden_gameplay_mutation: Loading/proposing/reviewing might heal, craft, consume rig, grant XP/money or start play; compare actual unchanged child facts.

source_scope.legacy: Static DEV/DIST creation runtime and original kit-table inspection informs strict boundaries; no Ruby/RGSS/RMXP execution or full historical parser port.
source_scope.variants: DEV grants/fallback differ from DIST persistence-only selection; preserve both.
source_scope.original_content: Four original cards: base Anchor/Lure and earned Dash amendments. Names/fiction/effects are not imported from historical sources.

frozen_controls: Startup exposes exact book SHA256 and four definitions without altering initial owner state.
Base card action proposes actual full draft only; review and confirmation remain separate.
Unreviewed/stale confirmation refuses; changed draft expires review.
Early earned-Dash proposal refuses without child preparation/progression/inventory mutation.
Actual base Lure card confirms, spends acquired components and materials, enters actual Crossing and earns actual survey progression.
After real earned level, earned Dash amendment can be proposed, reviewed and confirmed without heal/refund/grants; actual slot2 Dash acts under current owner.
Actual valid separately authored book moves base Lure Draw to slot2 without code changes; after confirmation slot1 refuses and slot2 executes actual skill.
Book variant carries its own identity and exact source bytes, not synthetic state injection.
Bad whole books reject before READY: missing/duplicate/unknown fields and IDs, wrong types, invalid whole-card eligibility, unsupported resource/XP grants and partial valid prefix.
Unknown/forged/stale card requests cannot fabricate preparation or resources.
Exact visible confirmed card provenance is separate from draft-card provenance; one isolated actual proposed-as-confirmed renderer is rejected.
Actual screenshots and source hashes recorded; source/config/protocol stable across execution.
Existing affected sampling/conditions/memory/field regressions reexecute through unchanged instruments because FieldHost/UI/dependency closure changed.

base_lure_survey: actual Trail rig assembly for both fittings
policies.valid_variant: In scratch copy of exact book, move base Lure slots from draw/null/null/null to null/draw/null/null; start same host with --preparations PATH, propose/review/confirm, enter using actual crafted rig, refuse slot1 and execute slot2 Draw.

measurement.unit: One explicitly scripted actual software journey; controls overlap, not participants or independent studies.
record: Actual runtime versions and owned host logs
Detected bad books and false renderer
measurement.claim: Bounded production/data-to-owner behavior and observation fidelity only; not human author productivity, preference, build diversity, gameplay balance or trained AI.

limits.processes: Bounded local hosts and actual Chromium stopped in finally; no sandbox claim.

specialist_basis: SCI-014 distinguish production contract from author usefulness/player meaning
SCI-076 actual content-to-owner controls rather than documentary integrity alone
SCI-077 negatives, unchanged-owner controls and no independent-seat/person counting
